svg.text: Figure 4.12b Entity Relationship Diagram, Part 2 of 4
Shops, subscriptions and AI generation: shop profiles, plan usage, plan payments, 3D generation jobs and design templates
reference: table drawn in full in another part
Types: ts = timestamptz, num = numeric, int = integer. Each line runs from a foreign key column (crow’s foot) to the table it references (bar), always to that table’s primary key.
shop_subscriptions.shop_id is both its primary key and a foreign key to shops.id, so every shop has at most one subscription row.
Generated from the live PostgreSQL schema (public schema, 16 tables) on 9 October 2026. auth.users is managed by Supabase Auth.
